name: Ambuja Cements Ltd.
business_summary: Adani Group cement flagship, India's second-largest cement group after UltraTech once ACC, Orient Cement, Penna and Sanghi are counted (model knowledge). Sells blended and OPC cement through trade (~65-70%) and non-trade channels; Q2 FY27 volume 16.5 Mt, sales Rs 9,197 cr, EBITDA Rs 1,271 cr (OPM 14%, ~Rs770/t derived). Announced on 2 Nov 2026 a Rs 14,500 cr, 30 MTPA expansion targeting 155 MTPA by FY30. Promoters 67.3%, FIIs 5.7%, DIIs 19.4%; almost debt-free. Stock Rs 385, -32% in 12 months.

revenue_mix.geography: India all-region; north/east/west/south via group plants (model knowledge)

cost_structure.input: Raw materials (limestone, gypsum, fly ash, slag)

exposures.mechanism: Power & fuel ~27% of costs (model knowledge), costs ~86% of sales (Q2: 7,926/9,197). Kiln fuel ~60% of that and ~70% of kiln fuel is petcoke/imported coal priced off seaborne coal -> ~11% of costs = 9.7% of sales. +15% -> +1.46% of sales; at 13.8% OPM EBITDA -10.6%; ~40% passed through in 3-6m -> -6.3%; EV/MCap ~0.95 (net cash), persistence 0.4 -> -2.4. Pack shows no significant empirical coal beta (t<1) but Q2 margin squeeze (OPM 19%->14%) is attributed to fuel/geopolitical costs.

evidence.note: NDTV Profit 29 Oct: Q2 revenue Rs 9,197 cr, sales volume 16.5 Mt; Moneycontrol/CNBC TV18: profit -90% on high base, margins squeezed by costs; Investing.com slides: margins compressed on fuel costs, expansion continues
Nomura: price hikes of Rs 12-15/bag needed to offset fuel costs (Moneycontrol 12 Oct); ET EnergyWorld 30 Sep: prices may rise up to Rs 15/bag in Oct; Nuvama neutral on rising costs (22 Oct)

exposures.mechanism: Freight ~28% of costs (model knowledge), ~40% diesel-linked road -> 11% of costs; retail diesel passes ~50% of a +10% Brent move -> costs +0.6% = 0.5% of sales -> EBITDA -3.7% at 13.8% OPM; 40% passed on -> -2.2%; x0.95 x persistence 0.4 -> -0.8; plus packaging/poly bags -> -1.0. Petcoke is handled in F_COAL_INTL (no double count). Empirical -0.81 (t -1.8) agrees.

evidence.note: NDTV Profit 29 Oct: Q2 revenue Rs 9,197 cr, sales volume 16.5 Mt; Moneycontrol/CNBC TV18: profit -90% on high base, margins squeezed by costs; Investing.com slides: margins compressed on fuel costs, expansion continues

exposures.mechanism: Imported petcoke/coal ~9.7% of sales landed in USD: +3% INR move -> +0.29% of sales -> EBITDA -2.1%; 40% pass-through, hedges partial -> -1.3% x0.95 x0.4 = -0.5; rounded -0.6. No export revenue to offset (mostly domestic).

evidence.note: fuel import share is model estimate

exposures.mechanism: Empirical -2.38 per +3% DXY (t -2.8): strongest statistical link in the pack, but no direct fundamental channel beyond imported-fuel cost and EM/FPI flow sensitivity (FIIs 5.7%; Adani-group stock with beta 1.1). Weight set at ~60% of the empirical coefficient and treated as a flows proxy; partly overlaps F_USDINR so assembler should not add both at full strength.

SSU +Rs10/bag (~+2.5% realisation). Revenue +2.5% drops almost entirely to EBITDA -> +2.5/13.8 = +18% EBITDA; EV/MCap 0.95; persistence 0.4 (price hikes in a 3-4 month window, competitor capacity additions erode) -> +6.9; rounded +6.5. Nomura says Rs12-15/bag hikes are needed just to offset fuel costs, so realised hikes are partly a recovery, not upside.

exposures.mechanism: Housing (individual home builders + real estate) ~65% of cement demand (model knowledge); elasticity of cement volume to housing sales ~0.25 -> +10% sales -> +1.6% volume. Contribution margin ~55% of realisation (variable cost ~45% of sales) -> +0.9% of sales EBITDA = +6.4% at 13.8% OPM; x0.95 x persistence 0.5 -> +3.0; shaded to +2.5 as RBI hiked on 7 Oct.

evidence.note: RBI hiked repo 25bp to 5.50% on 7 Oct 2026, stance 'calibrated tightening' (Reuters/The Hindu/Moneycontrol headlines)

exposures.mechanism: Infrastructure/government ~28% of cement demand; elasticity 0.5 -> +10% capex -> +1.4% volume -> +0.8% of sales EBITDA -> +5.5% at 13.8% OPM; x0.95 x0.5 -> +2.6; shaded for execution lags.

Net-cash balance sheet so little interest-cost effect (interest income +25bp on ~Rs10k cr cash = +Rs25 cr, ~+1% PBT, small). Dominant channel: P/E 31.6 duration (+25bp ~ -1.5% on long-duration equity) and housing-demand drag. RBI hiked 25bp to 5.50% on 7 Oct 2026, 'calibrated tightening'.

evidence.note: RBI hiked repo 25bp to 5.50% on 7 Oct 2026, stance 'calibrated tightening' (Reuters/The Hindu/Moneycontrol headlines)

exposures.mechanism: Sign ambiguous. Above-normal monsoon (+10% LPA) shuts construction sites in Q2/Q3 (volume hit 1-2% in affected months), partly offset by rural housing income lift later. Net slightly negative within the quarter.
Stronger housing support (PMAY-U 2.0, interest subvention) lifts IHB and affordable segments, ~65% of demand: +1 SSU ~ +0.8% volume -> +3% EBITDA -> x0.95 x0.5 -> +1.5, plus sentiment -> +2.0.

Limestone royalty/DMF hike raises raw-material cost (~14% of costs, limestone ~half); +1 SSU assumed ~+15% limestone levy -> costs +1% -> EBITDA -6% at 13.8% OPM x0.95 x persistence 1.0 gives -5.7 if unrecoverable but states notify with long lags and price pass-through ~85% -> -0.8.

company_links.mechanism: Same promoter group (Adani family 67.3% of Ambuja, Sep 2026). Group-wide sell-offs (Nov 2024 US indictment, Hindenburg Jan 2023) dragged Ambuja along; w = % move in Ambuja per 1% move in Adani Enterprises, rough 0.25 from group co-movement (model estimate). On 2 Nov 2026 'Adani Group stocks surge: Ambuja leads rally +5%' (NDTV Profit).

evidence.note: NDTV Profit: Ambuja led an Adani Group rally, +5%

company_links.mechanism: Same-group contagion and logistics interlinkage (ports/rail used for bulk cement and clinker movement); lower than ADANIENT because ADANIPORTS is a lower-beta, more institutional holding. Model estimate.
